header.title: Help is Here for Ghana e.V.
header.visionContent: To provide children and young people in Ghana with a vision of fair and unrestricted access to education and healthcare for all, and to support them in setting the course for their own futures — a future where no one is left behind and all children have equal starting conditions, regardless of their social or ethnic background.
header.missionContent: Our mission is to provide children from disadvantaged social backgrounds with access to education and healthcare through targeted projects, and to support and successfully implement these projects with the financial help of our donors.
header.foundation2015Title: 2015 - Founding year of the Help is Here Foundation in Ghana
header.foundation2015Content: The Help is Here Foundation was officially founded by Canni Tee-Lard in Accra, Ghana, as a non-profit organization with the vision of providing all children in Ghana with fair and unrestricted access to education and healthcare.
header.foundation2021Title: Founding year of Help is Here for Ghana e.V. in Germany
header.foundation2021Content: We founded the German sister association Help is Here for Ghana e.V. to support Canni’s excellent and long-standing work and to contribute to realizing the shared vision.
header.foundationUSATitle: 2025 – Founding of Help is Here Foundation US
header.foundationUSAContent: In 2025, we expanded our commitment by founding Help is Here Foundation US. The US branch supports our mission financially and through awareness work in the United States.

ueber_uns.title: About us
ueber_uns.p1: The Help is Here Foundation Ghana was founded in 2013 in <location>Accra</location>, Ghana, by Cannizzarra Tee-Lard. After a few smaller projects, the organization was officially registered in 2015 and has since been run as a non-profit association in Ghana. Canni's primary motivation for founding the association was to sustainably support the children and young people of her home community in Labadi, Accra, with small initiatives to give them a perspective for a better future. Since then, the organization has continued to develop and the projects are increasingly extending to other regions in Ghana. To ensure that donations reach the children directly and in a targeted manner, Canni always makes sure to keep administrative costs as low as possible.
ueber_uns.p2: For several years now, we have been supporting Canni and her association. We are united by a long-standing friendship with Canni, our love for Ghana, which has grown through personal stays, and our unbridled desire to make a contribution to giving children in Ghana a hopeful and equal future. In 2021, we decided to pool our support and founded the sister association "Help is Here for Ghana e.V."; in Germany, which is recognized as a non-profit organization.
